feed.subtitle: This is my personal website. I am a PhD student in the field of theoretical physics, with a focus on quantum field theory and string theory. I am passionate about exploring the fundamental nature of the universe and understanding the underlying principles that govern it. My research interests include quantum gravity, black holes, and the holographic principle. I am also interested in the intersection of physics and mathematics, particularly in the areas of topology and geometry.
